methodologies.name: MODIS LST scaling & QC filtering
methodologies.description: Convert MOD11A1 LST digital numbers to °C and keep only good-quality pixels.
assumptions: QA 00 = good quality; QA 01 with LST error flag ≤ 2 K accepted (built-up pixels are flagged 01 for emissivity uncertainty; strict 00-only removed the entire urban core)
Per-pixel QC tier is kept in the result (field qc_tier_day)
interpretation: Surface skin temperature; never presented as 2 m air temperature
limitations: tier-2 pixels carry up to 2 K retrieval error
methodologies.validation_note: Strict-tier subset reproduces the original acquisition exactly; values 17.1–44.7 °C; urban core now has 63–91 valid days instead of 0

methodologies.name: GPM IMERG V07 daily precipitation
methodologies.description: OPeNDAP spatial subset of IMERG Final daily precipitation over BBMP.
interpretation: Satellite–gauge merged estimate, not gauge observations

methodologies.name: MODIS NDVI 16-day composites (MOD13Q1)
methodologies.description: NDVI from MOD13Q1.061 250 m composites over the BBMP window.
methodologies.validation_note: Range −0.19–0.87, 99.98% valid; aggregated to 1 km by exact 4×4 nesting for LST association

methodologies.name: Mann–Kendall trend test + Sen's slope (with r1/TFPW and BH-FDR)
methodologies.description: Monotonic trend detection on annual means per POWER cell; magnitude by Sen's slope with ordered-rank 95% CI; lag-1 screening with TFPW; Benjamini–Hochberg across cells.
inputs: NASA POWER monthly → annual means (≥10 months)
assumptions: independence after TFPW when r1 significant
methodologies.corpus_support: P1, P2, P3 (MK/Sen); §7.4 CI and BH external
methodologies.validation_note: 12 unit tests incl. scipy kendalltau/theilslopes agreement

methodologies.name: Clear-sky LST composite, spatial contrast, elevation association
methodologies.description: Per-pixel mean of QC-good LST; anomaly vs area mean; Spearman ρ with SRTM elevation (no p-value).
inputs: SRTM elevation aggregated to MODIS pixels
interpretation: No hotspot threshold defined in methodology → no hotspot labels
limitations: no rural reference → not SUHI intensity

methodologies.name: Change-point / homogeneity tests (Pettitt, SNHT, PELT)
methodologies.corpus_support: P2, P4 (equations not printed for Pettitt)
methodologies.missing_specification: Pettitt statistic and significance approximation not given in corpus (§9.2 'Additional research needed'); no CI for change location.

methodologies.name: Global Moran's I
methodologies.missing_specification: Spatial weights definition for gridded fields not specified; field-significance method for trend maps is a stated gap (§11).

methodologies.name: Monthly temperature & precipitation forecast (1–12 months)
methodologies.description: Six candidates (climatology, seasonal naive, damped anomaly persistence, climatology+trend, pooled ridge, pooled gradient boosting) compared by rolling-origin validation; per-horizon selection on calibration MAE; empirical residual-quantile intervals.
methodologies.formula_latex: \hat y_{o+h}=\bar y_{m(o+h)}+\phi^h a_o \;\text{(damped persistence)},\quad PI_{1-\alpha}=\hat y + [q_{\alpha/2}(r_h), q_{1-\alpha/2}(r_h)]
inputs: NASA POWER monthly T2M, PRECTOTCORR 1981–2025, 25 cells
interpretation: Skill reported against climatology on held-out test data
methodologies.corpus_support: external (FPP3; Tashman 2000; Lei et al. 2018) — corpus has no forecasting methods

methodologies.name: Short-term (hours–days) forecasting
methodologies.missing_specification: Requires NWP forcing or multi-year sub-daily records; only one monsoon of GPM daily acquired.

methodologies.name: Multi-year / decadal projection
methodologies.missing_specification: Requires downscaled CMIP6 scenario projections; statistical extrapolation refused by design.

methodologies.name: SCS Curve Number rainfall–runoff scenario
methodologies.description: Daily direct runoff from observed GPM rainfall for baseline vs scenario impervious fraction; parameter ensemble.
interpretation: Hypothetical scenario, not a flood prediction
methodologies.doc_ref: USDA-NRCS NEH 630 Ch.10; TR-55 (1986); Hawkins et al. 2002
methodologies.corpus_support: external — corpus §13.1 lists runoff closures as absent

methodologies.name: Climate projections 2030–2100 (NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6)
methodologies.description: Summary of bias-corrected, downscaled CMIP6 runs for the Bengaluru 0.25° cell under SSP1-2.6/2-4.5/5-8.5: 20-year window means minus each model's 1995–2014 mean; multi-model median and min–max.
inputs: NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 tas, tasmax, pr, hurs, sfcWind (5 models)
interpretation: Projections conditional on the pathway, not forecasts
Range = model spread of a small ensemble
methodologies.doc_ref: Thrasher et al. 2022 Sci Data 9:262; IPCC AR6 WG1 conventions
methodologies.validation_note: Summary logic unit-tested; data acquisition must be run (scripts/acquire_cmip6.py)

methodologies.name: Simulation Lab — single-storm SCS-CN runoff
methodologies.description: Event SCS-CN with storm depth = intensity × duration, spatial footprint from the wettest observed GPM day; permeable share → CN.
